title: Rectangular bar
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with the Euler angles set to zero degrees and the translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on a new face. The sketch consists of a closed loop made up of four lines. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.0649, 0.0). The second line begins at (0.0649, 0.0) and extends to (0.0649, 0.75). The third line starts at (0.0649, 0.75) and goes to (0.0, 0.75). Finally, the fourth line completes the loop by connecting from (0.0, 0.75) back to the origin (0.0, 0.0). After drawing the sketch, apply a scaling factor of 0.75 to the entire two-dimensional shape. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it with the Euler angles set to zero and translating it with the vector set to zero. To create the three-dimensional model, extrude the two-dimensional sketch along the normal direction by 0.0125 units. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction, resulting in a new solid body. The final dimensions of the rectangular bar with rounded edges and a flat surface are: length of 0.06489962402585026 units, width of 0.7500000003627375 units, and height of 0.012476782976594485 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.0649, 0).lineTo(0.0649, 0.75).lineTo(0, 0.75).close()

# Extrude the sketch
extrusion = sketch.extrude(0.0125)

# Apply the sketch scale (if necessary)
# Note: The sketch scale is applied to the sketch before extrusion, but in this case, it is 0.75 which is the same as the width.
#       Therefore, we don't need to apply any additional scaling.

# The final model
r = extrusion

# Display the model
